last_analysis: I can't see any scores, so these choices rest on priors, not evidence. Every trial so far trained without errors, including 1 epoch at 405k steps (r2c1), so time limits aren't a risk at these sizes. My priors: (1) with a fresh design every episode and a dense reward, more samples per FLOP (fewer PPO epochs) probably helps; (2) gamma 0.99 should carry the +1 exact-build bonus back to early placements; (3) the global broadcast costs almost nothing and gives each placement score the overall build state; (4) attention or depth could help with ordering, at a cost in samples. This is the last round, so I'm aiming for the strongest combinations rather than clean single-variable tests. All three candidates use 1 PPO epoch with gamma 0.99 and lambda 0.95. They differ only in the network's context range: local (the base network plus the broadcast), global attention, or a deeper conv trunk with a stem skip.
